persona_gian.md: Young, and the moment his position turns on is not staged. This play's plots are 1291, 1848, 1863 and 1971; the Sprachenartikel of 1938, which made Romansh a national language and is the whole ground of what he carries, is not among them. Casting him in the ones that exist would be an anachronism, and the honest fix is a plot and not a casting. He is held by the culture-position and the language position and answers to the pitch.
persona_marco.md: A young Ticinese, born decades after the last plot, which is the federal vote of 1971. The same gap as Gian's: nothing in this plot line stages the standing of Italian as a national language, so there is no scene his generation could be cast in without inventing one. He is held by the culture-position and the language position and answers to the pitch.
